authority: Ticket19 conformance-record identity semantics; this profile does not make an empty registry executable

reject: duplicate object members at any depth
inputBoundary.numberParsing: arbitrary-precision decimal; generic binary floating-point binding before canonicalization is forbidden

primitiveEncoding.document: UTF-8 without BOM or insignificant whitespace
primitiveEncoding.strings: preserve the exact Unicode scalar sequence without normalization; use the unique JSON escape for quote, backslash, and control characters; emit every other scalar directly as UTF-8; never escape slash
primitiveEncoding.numbers: emit the arbitrary-precision mathematical value in plain notation without exponent or leading plus; remove insignificant leading and trailing zeroes; emit negative zero as 0; omit the decimal point for an integer value
primitiveEncoding.null: lowercase null only where the selected record schema and probe ValueType permit it

objectMemberOrder.closedRecordObjects: the exact member order declared by the selected record schema, omitting absent optional members without changing the relative order of present members
objectMemberOrder.mapLikeObjects: sort member names by unsigned UTF-8 byte sequence
mapLikeLocations: expected.kind=LITERAL value objects at every depth

arrayOrder.duplicateNamedKey: reject before hashing even when JSON array items are otherwise distinct

identityDigests.concatenation: UTF-8 domain bytes followed immediately by canonical projection bytes

caseSignature.meaning: active-case duplicate and supersession-chain identity comparison

oracleSignature.meaning: active-oracle reuse and supersession-chain identity comparison

inputIdentity.projection: the selected closed input union after removing identitySha256

faultIdentity.projection: the selected closed faultSchedule union after removing identitySha256
